development_window_offset_search.cost: per-frame one-to-one Euclidean foot distance, capped at100 px; inspect only, not frozen scoring alignment

pixel_alignment_audit.note: Direct GSR boxes at a development-selected constant offset remain small/partial and visibly displaced for several people. Declared image dimensions alone do not establish or disprove a transform. The supplied 65 pitch landmarks visually follow field lines, but that does not validate player-box timing/geometry.

auxiliary_data_audit.remap_result: Inverse remapping collapses source points toward image center; no evidence this is the GSR-to-current-video transform. Not used for scoring.
auxiliary_data_audit.padding_info_csv: Local file contains Google 404 HTML, not CSV; not usable geometry metadata.
auxiliary_data_audit.mot_readme: Describes different four-minute 4096x1080 challenge clips; no paired MOT file was found under current dataset/cache paths.

decision: Do not present full-video identity metrics from the official GT until the spatial and temporal transform is independently validated. Use sparse visually inspected person associations for current development instead.
